central_question: What survives when the Alan Parsons Project deep-mechanics result and the Robert Miles Children/version experiments are forced through external and prospective controls?

external_support: Sirius was actually adapted in key to function as the intro to Eye in the Sky.
I Robot actually combines sequenced electronics with human choral/live layers.
Don't Answer Me actually uses deliberate Spector-like production contrast.
Ammonia Avenue actually combines industrial/scientific subject matter with human-scale song/orchestral production.

robert_miles_sha_witness.known_children_calibration: Dream vs Original Hamming 127/256; post-hoc shifted LCS 97254 length 5.
robert_miles_sha_witness.prospective_result: Across five new related version-pairs, LCS>=5 occurred 0/5; across five controls, 0/5.
robert_miles_sha_witness.fixed_position_hint: Related mean fixed hex matches 6.0 vs control 3.4, raw descriptive permutation p=0.03968, but nonconfirmatory after five preregistered metrics/dependence; simple four-SHA-metric Bonferroni sensitivity approximately 0.1587.

robert_miles_audio_witness.design: Three disjoint related version pairs versus three disjoint same-catalog controls; decoded audio features frozen before extraction.

chroma.observation: All three related pair chroma similarities exceed all three controls.

robert_miles_audio_witness.spectral_profile: Near-saturated in both groups; low discrimination.
robert_miles_audio_witness.tempo: Related closer on average but not stable enough for confirmation.

two_witness_result.witness_A_cryptographic: SHA-256 treats related audio versions approximately like unrelated byte inputs; the attractive 97254 five-hex observation did not replicate prospectively.
two_witness_result.witness_B_perceptual: Decoded audio retains family structure, most visibly in pitch-class/chroma space and partly in whole-track dynamic shape.
two_witness_result.interpretation: The same pair of works can be close under a perceptual representation and essentially independent under a cryptographic representation. The representation chooses which differences survive.

cross_artist_operator.alan_parsons: Hold or introduce a stable musical/production reference while another layer changes; meaning emerges from controlled contrast and continuity.
cross_artist_operator.robert_miles: Related versions preserve harmonic family while arrangement/anchor layers change; the audio representation exposes that family while SHA-256 deliberately erases it.

equations: F_audio(X1) ~= F_audio(X2) for musically related versions on selected features
SHA256(X1) !~= SHA256(X2) even when X1 and X2 are musically related
delta_R(X1,X2) is interpretable only relative to what R preserves
janus_formula.law: NO REPRESENTATION IS THE WORLD; EACH REPRESENTATION PRESERVES SOME INVARIANTS AND DESTROYS OTHERS.

ibm_quantum_boundary.proper_future_role_if_available: Quantum hardware could be studied only under a separately frozen computational experiment; it would not turn SHA-256 digest shape into musical meaning by default.

epistemic_assessment.best_current_claim: Two independent music cases support a representation-sensitive difference operator: useful structure appears when the representation preserves musical invariants, while cryptographic hashing deliberately destroys those invariants.

next_gate.name: REPRESENTATION_LADDER_REPLICATION
next_gate.proposal: Freeze a ladder of representations before new tracks: raw bytes -> SHA256 -> decoded PCM -> spectral/chroma -> perceptual fingerprint -> semantic/formal music map. For each representation, preregister which invariants should survive and test related versus unrelated disjoint pairs.

canonical_seal: APP AND ROBERT MILES CONVERGE ON THE SAME SAFE LAW: HOLD THE RIGHT REFERENCE FRAME, CHANGE ONE LAYER, AND THE DIFFERENCE BECOMES LEGIBLE. CHANGE THE REPRESENTATION TO SHA-256 AND THE MUSICAL FAMILY DISAPPEARS BY DESIGN.
